description: Where an attached MASKING POLICY becomes visible (live-verified): DESCRIBE TABLE's policy name cell and GET_DDL's WITH MASKING POLICY clause both spell the policy in FULL under ITS schema however little the attaching statement wrote; UNSET clears; the type rule names no column and spells the POLICY's type in the internal vocabulary (TEXT, FIXED, REAL) while the column keeps its canonical SQL spelling; within a family the parameters are ignored; argument/return mismatch refused at CREATE; missing policy/schema refusals; no-op detach; positioned unknown-column refusal; re-attach a no-op under every spelling that resolves to the same policy; a different policy needs FORCE. Converted 1:1 from ddl/MaskingPolicyAttachmentTest (now retired).
